annotations.title: List what's been said about a workflow's steps

description: Every claim about a WORKFLOW's steps, oldest first: the step (nodeId; null = the workflow as a whole), the role or person (subject), the relation, who says so (sourceKind + sourceLabel), when it was true (validFrom/validTo), and origin — AI_PROPOSED claims are waiting for a person to review. Claims that disagree coexist; each keeps its source.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
